purpose: Turn authentic page bytes into independently verifiable offer claims; no catalog hydration in this work order.
requirements: Do not use fixed candidate objects as a verification authority. Implement extraction or validation that fails closed unless every published claim is supported by the recorded raw bytes.

For every field that will be displayed (title, price/benefit, conditions, validity/recurrence, locality), record a verbatim UTF-8 span plus byte offsets, occurrence count, source raw SHA-256, URL, final URL and capture timestamp.

Normalize HTML entities before matching but retain raw byte offsets and the exact raw substring. A claim may not be marked VERIFIED when its exact value or an unambiguous equivalent does not occur in the source.
Treat branch locality as separate evidence unless the exact same source explicitly ties the offer to Da Nang. Do not infer branch applicability from nationwide branding or historic address data.

Treat validity as UNKNOWN/HELD if no source span specifies it. Do not infer 2026, month-end, recurring days, exclusions, membership eligibility or app redemption from a title or a general landing page.
Run negative tests that mutate a price, a locality, an expiry and a source SHA; each must fail verification. Test duplicate spans and entity-encoded VND values.
Keep prior R1 forensic snapshot and receipt immutable. Place R2 output in a new run directory and issue superseding status only; do not edit historic records.
Return actual verified count and HELD count. Target numbers are not acceptance criteria and must not be filled with menu prices or generic membership statements.
No staging hydrate, candidate packaging, production deployment, alias, scheduler changes or rollback.
acceptance_gate: CEO review required; no automatic promotion
